concerns.text: SC-002 ('validity of the dataset-variable fit is measured by verifying that the SoCRATES dataset contains all required variables (emotional reactivity, cultural identity)') has no implementing task. The coverage table lists FR-001..FR-007, SC-003, SC-005 but omits SC-002 entirely; T101 generates synthetic trajectories but never verifies dataset-variable fit against the SoCRATES source. Add a task (or fold into T101's verification) that checks the required variables exist and reports the result.

The Revision behavior section maps T013/T014/T015→T101, T019→T103, T027/T050→T105, T024/T025/T026/T028/T045A/T047A→T106, T049→T102, T020b/T033b→T104 — T028b is absent. No task measures or asserts generation runtime/memory (T107 measures inference throughput only). Add a generation-time/memory check to T101's verification or a small measurement task.
